title: Unrelated files can be selected through other files' "Renaming input field"
line: Clicking the part of a desktop rename field that covers the icon below no longer selects that other file.
explanation: The rename field was created as a child of the Folder View's MouseEventListener, which sees every press and release of its children. Presses and clicks on the field were skipped with childAt() checks (bug 494558), but the release was not, so releasing over the part of the field that covers the icon below cleared the selection and selected that icon. The field is now created as a child of the view's root item instead, so the listener never sees its clicks, and the childAt() workarounds are removed.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: Keep rename field clicks from reaching the icons

Clicking the part of a rename field covering the icon below selected
that icon, since the field was a child of the mouse listener that sees
all its children's clicks. Create it outside and drop old workarounds.

BUG: 517584

media.caption: Renaming the long-named file; the pointer is on the bottom of the field, where it covers b.txt (b.txt shows its hover highlight).
After clicking there: b.txt is selected and the file being renamed is deselected, with the field still open.
Same position with the fix: b.txt is not highlighted under the field.
After clicking there: only the text cursor moves; the renamed file stays selected, b.txt is untouched.
Folder View widget, same steps: before the click and after it, only the cursor moves.

review.text: Excellent root-cause fix that parents the inline RenameEditor to main instead of MouseEventListener, preventing the listener from intercepting press, hover, release, or click events over the overlapping rename field and removing the earlier childAt() workarounds from bug 494558. Moving the editor outside the listener also naturally clears the false hover highlight on the icon below, and verification covers desktop and Folder View widget workflows including text context menu, commit, and cancel.

reviews.text: Excellent root-cause fix that parents the inline RenameEditor to main instead of MouseEventListener, preventing the listener from intercepting press, hover, release, or click events over the overlapping rename field and removing the earlier childAt() workarounds from bug 494558. Moving the editor outside the listener also naturally clears the false hover highlight on the icon below, and verification covers desktop and Folder View widget workflows including text context menu, commit, and cancel.

Right root cause: the RenameEditor was a child of the MouseEventListener, whose childMouseEventFilter sees every press/release of its children, and only press/click were guarded (494558), so the release selected the icon under the field. Reparenting the editor to main (a later sibling, so stacked above the listener) removes the whole class of leaks and lets the childAt() workarounds go; getXY() already maps y through main and x uses scrollArea.viewport.x with no horizontal margin, so placement is unchanged (and the latent back-button topMargin offset goes away). Screenshots clearly show b.txt selected before and only the text cursor moving after, on both desktop and widget, and the regression checks cover right-click (494558), commit on outside click and Escape. Small, clean QML diff with an accurate message and BUG: 517584.
